text: dsh-continue 是一款面向 DSH 网页客户端的输入栏快捷操作插件。它通过客户端插槽在发送按钮旁添加「继续」和「讲人话」两个按钮，点击后将对应文本写入当前草稿并提交；已有草稿会保留，并在新的一行追加操作文本。适合长会话中需要反复让模型继续生成，或希望快速请求通俗解释的 DSH 网页用户。按钮位于输入栏右侧，动作由用户主动点击触发。插件不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-continue adds Continue and plain language buttons beside the DSH web composer send button. Clicking either appends its prompt to the draft and submits it, preserving existing text. It helps users quickly continue a response or request a simpler explanation.
想在 DSH 输入栏旁边放一个继续生成的按钮。
有没有一点就能让模型接着回答的快捷操作？
让 DSH 网页版能快速发送通俗解释的请求。
输入框已有草稿时，我想追加快捷指令而不是覆盖内容。
Can I add a one click action to continue the model's response in DSH?
I want a quick way to ask DSH to explain an answer in plain language.
dsh-continue 的功能「继续生成」：输入栏发送按钮旁提供「继续」按钮。点击后将「继续」写入草稿并提交，已有草稿会保留并在新行追加。
dsh-continue 的功能「通俗解释」：输入栏提供「讲人话」按钮。点击后把「请讲人话，简洁生动的解释一遍」写入草稿并提交；原有草稿内容会保留。
长对话里模型停下来时，想点一下就发出继续请求。
I need to preserve my unfinished composer draft while adding a quick prompt.

dsh-continue README · 这是什么：**dsh-continue** 是面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)(dsh) 的极简开源插件。

写代码到一半,AI 干到一半停了,你大概率要打「继续」。一次两次没关系,几百轮下来,你其实只是在替 AI 完成打字这件体力活。这个插件在输入栏「发送」按钮右侧加两个快捷按钮:

| 按钮 | 发送内容 |
| --- | --- |
| **继续** | `继续` |
| **讲人话** | `请讲人话，简洁生动的解释一遍` |

全部行为只有这些:点了就发,不覆盖你已经打好的草稿(草稿非空时另起一行追加)。插件**不修改 dsh 任何源码**,只挂一行浏览器插件,可随 dsh 平滑升级。

dsh-continue README · 安装：```bash
git clone https://github.com/flg1217/dsh-continue.git
cd dsh-continue
pnpm install          # 无第三方依赖,基本是空操作
dsh plugin --profile web add <dsh-continue 目录>

安装完成后**重启 dsh web**,输入栏「发送」按钮右侧即出现「继续」「讲人话」两个按钮。

> 本地开发也可以直接在本仓库根目录 `dsh plugin --profile web add .` 装配,行为相同。

dsh-continue README · 兼容性与权限：- 兼容 dsh web profile(npx 版或源码版均可);验证于 dsh rc.8。
- **权限范围**:插件仅浏览器端两个按钮,宿主半无逻辑,不访问文件、网络或环境变量。

dsh-continue README · 卸载：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-continue
```

或手工清理:移除 profile(`~/.dsh/profiles/web`)中 `dsh-continue` 的 insert 行与 package.json dependencies 条目,重启 dsh web 即完全移除。

dsh-continue README · 工作原理：插件为双面结构——浏览器半干活,宿主半留白:

```
┌─────────────── 宿主进程(node 半)─────────────────────┐
│ src/index.js   插件入口(apply 为空,仅为挂 profile 行) │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─────────────── 浏览器(web 半)────────────────────────┐

- **装配**:`cordis.patch.yml`(bundle patch)注入插件行;package.json 的 `dsh.client` 声明把浏览器半加载进 GUI
- **按钮**:挂在 `conversation.input.right` 插槽(order:100),渲染在发送按钮右侧
- **发送**:草稿为空直接发送按钮文本;草稿非空则另起一行追加,不覆盖你正在输入的内容

dsh-continue README · 参与开发：```bash
git clone https://github.com/flg1217/dsh-continue.git
cd dsh-continue
dsh plugin --profile web add .   # 本地装配,改 src/client.js 后刷新即生效
```

详见 [docs/CONTRIBUTING.zh.md](docs/CONTRIBUTING.zh.md)。

dsh-continue README · What it is：**dsh-continue** is a minimal open-source plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)(dsh).

Halfway through a task, the agent stalls and you type "continue". Once or twice is fine — but after a few hundred rounds you're just doing typing work for the AI. This plugin adds two quick buttons next to the send button:

| Button | Sends |
| --- | --- |
| **继续** | `继续` |
| **讲人话** | `请讲人话，简洁生动的解释一遍` |

dsh-continue README · What it is：That's the whole plugin: click to send. It never overwrites your draft (when the draft is non-empty it appends on a new line). The plugin **modifies no dsh source** — it is a single client-side line, so it keeps working across dsh upgrades.

dsh-continue README · Install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/flg1217/dsh-continue.git
cd dsh-continue
pnpm install          # no third-party deps, basically a no-op
dsh plugin --profile web add <dsh-continue directory>

**Restart dsh web** after installing — the "继续" and "讲人话" buttons appear to the right of the send button.

> For local development you can also mount the repo root directly: `dsh plugin --profile web add .` in this directory.

dsh-continue README · Compatibility & permissions：- Works with the dsh web profile (npx or source build); verified on dsh rc.8.
- **Permission scope**: the plugin is two client-side buttons only — the host half has no logic and touches no files, network, or environment variables.

dsh-continue README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-continue
```

Or clean up manually: remove the `dsh-continue` insert entry from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and its dependency line in `package.json`, then restart dsh web.

dsh-continue README · How it works：The plugin is dual-faced — the browser half does the work, the host half stays empty:

```
┌─────────────── Host process (node half) ─────────────┐
│ src/index.js   plugin entry (empty apply, just mounts │
│                a profile line)                        │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

dsh-continue README · How it works：- **Assembly**: `cordis.patch.yml` (bundle patch) inserts the plugin line; the `dsh.client` manifest in package.json loads the browser half into the GUI
- **Buttons**: mounted on the `conversation.input.right` slot (order: 100), rendered right of the send button
- **Send**: sends the button text when the draft is empty; otherwise appends on a new line without touching your draft

dsh-continue README · Development：```bash
git clone https://github.com/flg1217/dsh-continue.git
cd dsh-continue
dsh plugin --profile web add .   # local mount; refresh after editing src/client.js
```
